findings.text: The render-only CLI log cited by the report records project_src '/nova/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/gate-b/absolute-flux-error.svg' while its own path field is 'docs/figures/figure-and-solver-audit/fsa-extract-frozen-current-gate-driver/absolute-flux-error.svg', the new fsa output location. The committed driver cannot emit that pair: after the final refactor _draw_error_figure and _draw_comparison_panel build both fields from _figure_location(output), which for that output yields project_src '/nova/figures/figure-and-solver-audit/fsa-extract-frozen-current-gate-driver/absolute-flux-error.svg' (computed directly from the committed module). The pre-refactor value is exactly the source blob's hardcoded '/nova/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/gate-b/' + output.name, which is what render.log and the run-directory driver-working-copy.py both carry; driver-working-copy.py differs from the committed driver only in this project_src/_figure_location refactor. render.log was therefore captured before the last edit and not regenerated, so a reader reconciling the cited log against the committed code finds a field that disagrees. The reproduction result is unaffected - it is validated at the committed revision by committed-head.log and by the review's independent head gate, and the SVGs persist no project_src. The fix is to regenerate render.log from the committed driver or cite the refactor explicitly.

gate_arms_note: The reviewed run's baseline_suite (revision f2ea3fc1511f3deddce9328f7dff4f72771c7af5, command JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider .../tests/test_frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py --basetemp=/tmp/frozen-current-baseline, completed=true, exit_status=1, 3 failed / 0 passed, log baseline.log) and after_suite (revision 0f8f89c9ca3835816233cf3416c8778d7a744a70, same file, completed=true, exit_status=0, 0 failed / 3 passed, log committed-head.log) both ran to their summary lines and both name a log on disk. added_failure_ids is after_suite.failure_ids minus baseline_suite.failure_ids; both arms' failure sets are disjoint-empty on the head side, so added_failure_count=0. The pair is a genuine failure discriminator rather than a label: the base arm (product tree at f2ea3fc1 with the candidate test file present, the newly authored driver withheld) fails all three tests with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'benchmarks.frozen_current_flux_image_gate' (baseline.log:113-115), while the committed-head arm at 0f8f89c9 passes all three (committed-head.log:14-16). Confirmed on disk that f2ea3fc1 is the parent of 0f8f89c9 and that benchmarks/frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py is absent at base and added by the reviewed commit. Independently reproduced by the review at 0f8f89c9 in the reviewed worktree with the shared environment: JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu .../tests/test_frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py => 3 passed in 23.74s, EXIT=0 (review-head-gate.log), and the declared negative control re-run by feeding a receipt copy with one row removed through NOVA_FROZEN_CURRENT_RECEIPT => 1 failed, 2 passed in 10.27s, EXIT=1, only test_render_only_reproduces_receipted_panel_set failing at the six-row guard (review-negctrl.log).

justifications.durability: The extraction is committed locally at 0f8f89c9 (parent f2ea3fc1), detached and unpushed as expected for a worker; the coordinator owns the merge and push. The added test is a real regression guard rather than decoration: the negative control shows it goes red on exactly the mutation it names, and the reproduction test refuses any measurement path. Two weaknesses keep this below the top band. First, the render-only entry point has four distinct refusal guards (unknown schema, incomplete receipt, six-row order, part/row and part/revision equality) but only the six-row guard is exercised by a failing test; the other three are neither driven red nor asserted green by name, so a future edit that silently weakened them would not be caught. Second, the two reproduced SVGs are byte-different from the originals, so the committed pair pins the drawn elements (contours, wall, labels, marker centres, shared levels) but not the bytes; the test compares drawings, not digests, which is honest and disclosed but means the artifacts are not a bit-identity regression baseline. Finding 1 (stale render.log) is also a durability point: an evidence log left at an intermediate revision.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced first-hand. (1) Head gate re-run at the reviewed head 0f8f89c9 in the reviewed worktree with the shared venv gives 3 passed in 23.74s, EXIT=0 (review-head-gate.log). (2) The declared negative control was independently re-run by writing a copy of the committed gate-b receipt with its last row popped and pointing NOVA_FROZEN_CURRENT_RECEIPT at it: 1 failed, 2 passed in 10.27s, EXIT=1, with only test_render_only_reproduces_receipted_panel_set failing on ValueError: the receipt must contain all six declared rows in order (review-negctrl.log) - so the guard is shown to fire on exactly the input the manifest names, not merely present. (3) The report's AST claim is exact: parsing the cited source blob and the committed driver, module-level function count is 44 -> 46, with 40 unchanged, 4 changed (_draw_comparison_panel, _draw_error_figure, _parse, main) and 2 added (_figure_location, render_from_receipt); every numerical measurement function is in the unchanged set (independent AST comparison). (4) The two committed reproduced SVGs digest to exactly reproduction-comparison.json's reproduced_sha256 (c24a845a... and ab8678...), and the historical originals digest to its reference_sha256 (a0147919... and 936f2119...); six parts are present. The receipt, parts and historical SVGs are outside the commit's changed-file set, so they are byte-for-byte unchanged. Deduction for finding 1: render.log records a project_src that the committed driver cannot emit, showing the log was captured before the final project_src refactor and not regenerated; the reproduction result and the headline gate are unaffected (both validated at the committed revision), but a reader reconciling render.log against the committed code finds a field that disagrees.
justifications.fit: Minimal and idiomatic. The change is one recovered benchmark module plus one focused test file; the only structural addition is the _figure_location helper factored out of the two draw functions; there is no new abstraction, no new dependency, and no change to the numerical measurement implementation (45 of 49 walked functions and all 40 module-level measurement functions unchanged). Names and docstrings describe mechanism, not a plan or ticket ('Reproduce the stored figure pair without measuring or deleting any rows'). No plan, sprint, milestone or ticket identifier appears in the two changed source files (the only regex hits are the artifact directory path components and the data schema string nova.frozen-current-flux-image.v1). Scoped ruff check over the two changed files passes with no findings (confirmed independently).
justifications.goal_fidelity: Every clause of the done-when is met and independently verified. The driver exists from the cited source: git -C <worktree> rev-parse refs/s19-tips/cca-gate-b-finish-and-attribute is 48a5764b5fe40465da16c2b65ae0f5b5af0c9fb5 (the gate-b receipt's own measurement_driver_revision), and that ref's benchmarks/frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py blob is f972849545f16e2f22be550db88fbfea84167310, exactly the blob the manifest names. The module's three benchmark imports (benchmarks.solovev_certificate, benchmarks.solovev_cut_cell_moments, benchmarks.split_fit_jump_field) are all present at base f2ea3fc1 (git cat-file -e) and resolve by import (import-probe.log: EXTRACTED_DRIVER_IMPORT=passed); the driver does not import profile_support_amplitude_gate or rung_a_certificate_resolve (grep shows only the local variable 'profile_support', not the PSAG module), so the node's 'no sibling extraction required' is a verified import result, not a name guess. The committed diff touches no path under nova/. The driver imports at HEAD with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu (test_driver_imports_from_this_checkout, independently re-run green). render_from_receipt reads the committed receipt + six parts, refuses a receipt that is not the complete six ordered rows or whose part disagrees with its row or with the measurement revision, and draws both panels without calling measure_rung/aggregate/_run_all/certificate._case_machine (the reproduction test monkeypatches all four to raise AssertionError and the render still succeeds) and without deleting the parts (the test asserts the six parts are byte-unchanged across the call). Both SVGs reproduce: the test compares axes count, contour/wall path d+style, comment labels, marker centres and shared levels against the committed historical originals and passes; reproduction-comparison.json records byte_identical=false for both with the drawn differences stated (axis dots become triangles and line-cross saddle markers become filled crosses under the current media style). The report lists the brought-over file, its source tip and blob and every adaptation with a reason; the manifest records byte-identity and drawn differences for each SVG. Gate: head 3 passed with zero added failures against the base arm. Not full marks only because one cited evidence log predates a final edit (finding 1), which is an evidence-bookkeeping point rather than a goal miss.
justifications.scope_discipline: The review range f2ea3fc1..0f8f89c9 changes exactly four repository paths, all inside the run's granted write scope: benchmarks/frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py, tests/test_frozen_current_flux_image_gate.py and the two reproduced SVGs under docs/figures/figure-and-solver-audit/fsa-extract-frozen-current-gate-driver/. No path under nova/, no plan file, no shared index, no concurrent-node path. The reviewed worktree is clean at 0f8f89c9 (git status shows nothing outside .venv). The node correctly wrote no evidence prose: its prompt grants the fragment path only as a write target while its landing contract states 'Your done-when names an artifact, so this node may write that artifact. It permits no other figure and no evidence prose.', so the absence of docs/evidence/fragments/figure-and-solver-audit/fsa-extract-frozen-current-gate-driver.html is compliance, not omission - the report states this reasoning. Neither reproduced SVG exceeds the 300,000-byte data-file cap (92,547 and 70,947 bytes). The single commit carries a conventional subject and an explanatory body with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in the subject, the body or the added source. Deducted one for the two committed reproduction SVGs, which are inside the granted path but add a second copy of artifacts whose originals remain canonical; the done-when asked for the reproduction, so this is a minor footprint note rather than an out-of-scope edit.
